title: Emmy Blotnick: What's Her Secret?
overview: In the follow-up to her critically acclaimed album PARTY NIGHTS, Emmy Blotnick returns to the stage of Brooklyn’s Union Hall with absurd yet relatable takes on marriage, dogs, and getting lost in Sephora. Crack open a fresh jar of Jennifer Lopez-brand butt cream and enjoy Emmy Blotnick’s latest special WHAT’S HER SECRET?
